get_solver_from_sig: load a trained solver model from an XP signature string with optional config overrides
get_solver_from_args: load a trained solver model from command line arguments with optional config overrides
get_test_metrics: compute test metrics between estimated and ground truth output per recording across epochs
SentenceFeatures_generate: generate feature tensors from a list of words with their specified durations
predict: predict MEG responses from a solver and feature tensor for a given subject or average
